Antenna.description: Scalar co-polar antenna (section 5.2); ``boresight`` required unless isotropic.
Antenna.title: Antenna

AntennaProvenance.description: Provenance of a tabulated antenna pattern.
AntennaProvenance.title: AntennaProvenance

ControlModel.description: Control granularity; ``groups`` lists physical cell indices per control group.
ControlModel.title: ControlModel

ControllerModel.description: A controller (section 9.2). Built-ins name their class in ``impl``.
ControllerModel.title: ControllerModel

DiffuseTap.description: One exponential-PDP tap of the diffuse term.
DiffuseTap.title: DiffuseTap

Edge.description: Knife edge given as a segment; applies to the paths it intersects (section 5.9).
Edge.title: Edge

Environment.description: Ground, walls, occluders, knife edges and diffuse multipath (section 9.2).
Environment.title: Environment

FailuresModel.description: Random failure map rates (keyed RNG purpose ``failure/<panel>``).

gamma_dead.description: Complex number: a real number or [re, im].
gamma_dead.title: Gamma Dead

FailuresModel.title: FailuresModel

Grid.description: Cell grid; cell index ``n = iv*n_u + iu`` (u fastest).
Grid.title: Grid

Ground.description: Flat ground plane z = ``height_m`` with complex permittivity (section 5.7).
Ground.title: Ground

InitialModel.description: Initial configuration: a ``fill`` state for every control or explicit ``states``.
InitialModel.title: InitialModel

LatencyModelSpec.description:
Controller latency: ``fixed_s`` plus optional ``jitter`` ``"uniform:a,b"`` or
``"exp:mean"`` (s), drawn from RNG purpose ``ctrl.latency/<name>``.
LatencyModelSpec.title: LatencyModelSpec

Node.description: A node: exactly one of ``position_m`` or ``trajectory``.
Node.title: Node

Numerics.description: Numerical policy (section 9.2). Defaults are the spec's.

t_u_s.description: Snapshot interval, s; may only LOWER the automatic value.
t_u_s.title: T U S

Numerics.title: Numerics

Pose.description: Panel pose: centre (m), unit normal n and in-plane u axis; v = n x u (section 3.1).
Pose.title: Pose

RunModel.description: Run mode and policies (sections 4.6-4.10). ``stall_timeout_s`` is wall time.
RunModel.title: RunModel

Rwp1dTrajectory.description:
1-D random waypoint on the segment [p0_m, p1_m] (Bettstetter), constant speed, legs
keyed by RNG purpose ``mobility/<node>``.
Rwp1dTrajectory.title: Rwp1dTrajectory

Rwp2dTrajectory.description:
2-D random waypoint in the rectangle ``bounds_m = [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]]`` at height
``z_m``.
Rwp2dTrajectory.title: Rwp2dTrajectory

StatesModel.description:
Response states: a built-in ``library`` (``"name"`` or ``"name(k=v, ...)"`` for
parametric families) or a state-library ``file``; ``assume_mag`` per state label for
``mag: null`` states (recorded as ASSUMED).
StatesModel.title: StatesModel

StreamModel.description:
A TX or RX stream of a node (sections 3.3, 4.5, 9.2).

``occupied_bw_hz`` (TX only) defaults to ``0.8*f_s`` at resolution, with a warning.
``noise_figure_db`` and ``adc_clip`` are RX-only.
StreamModel.title: StreamModel

Tiles.description:
Tile layout; ``gap_m`` between adjacent tiles; ``gap_gamma`` optional structural
reflection of exposed gaps (None = inert).

anyOf.description: Complex number: a real number or [re, im].

Tiles.title: Tiles

TraceTrajectory.description:
CSV trace ``t_s,x_m,y_m,z_m`` (cubic spline, no extrapolation); path relative to the
scenario file.
TraceTrajectory.title: TraceTrajectory

Traffic.description: An in-process traffic generator feeding a TX stream (studies).
Traffic.title: Traffic

TransitionModelSpec.description:
Default transition (section 4.7); ``duration_s`` defaults to the panel's
``reconfiguration_time_s``.
TransitionModelSpec.title: TransitionModelSpec

Wall.description: Finite planar polygon wall, image order 1 (section 5.8).
Wall.title: Wall

WaypointsTrajectory.description:
Piecewise linear through ``positions_m`` at exact times ``t_s`` (strictly
increasing, same length); held before the first and after the last waypoint.
WaypointsTrajectory.title: WaypointsTrajectory
